SELECT "user_id"
FROM (SELECT * FROM "users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL)
USING SAMPLE reservoir(10000 ROWS) REPEATABLE (7)
ORDER BY "user_id"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT k.i - 1 AS __kumo_batch__, k.v.f0 AS __kumo_id__, k.v.f1 AS __kumo_end__, k.v.f2 AS __kumo_start__
  FROM unnest(from_json(?, '[{"f0":"BIGINT","f1":"TIMESTAMP_NS","f2":"TIMESTAMP_NS"}]'))
    WITH ORDINALITY AS k(v, i)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, "ordered_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND CAST("ordered_at" AS TIMESTAMP) <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND CAST("ordered_at" AS TIMESTAMP) > tmp.__kumo_start__
ORDER BY tmp.__kumo_batch__, CAST("ordered_at" AS TIMESTAMP), "order_id", "ordered_at"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT k.i - 1 AS __kumo_batch__, k.v.f0 AS __kumo_id__
  FROM unnest(from_json(?, '[{"f0":"BIGINT"}]'))
    WITH ORDINALITY AS k(v, i)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__) AS __kumo_matches__, "user_id", "age", "country"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "users"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
  ORDER BY "age", "country", "user_id"
) = 1

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT k.i - 1 AS __kumo_batch__, k.v.f0 AS __kumo_id__, k.v.f1 AS __kumo_time__
  FROM unnest(from_json(?, '[{"f0":"BIGINT","f1":"TIMESTAMP_NS"}]'))
    WITH ORDINALITY AS k(v, i)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, "order_id", "user_id", "product_id", "quantity", "ordered_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND CAST("ordered_at" AS TIMESTAMP) <= tmp.__kumo_time__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
  ORDER BY CAST("ordered_at" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, "order_id", "ordered_at", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"
) <= 32
ORDER BY tmp.__kumo_batch__, CAST("ordered_at" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, "order_id", "ordered_at", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT k.i - 1 AS __kumo_batch__, k.v.f0 AS __kumo_id__
  FROM unnest(from_json(?, '[{"f0":"BIGINT"}]'))

SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__) AS __kumo_matches__, "product_id", "category", "price"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "products"
  ON "product_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
  ORDER BY "category", "price", "product_id"
) = 1
